text:
Ryan M: Cutover in ~50m. Hotfix PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8123 is blocking the release — we need two signoffs before midnight PT. CI was flaky earlier, so prefer one reviewer + one approver. Who can be the second set of eyes?
Alex K: I reviewed earlier, left one small comment about the timeout. I'm happy to sign off after CI is green. Will re-check in 10m.
Sara P: @Alex K if you give your signoff I'll take the second review and merge. I'm around for the next hour, quick smoke looked okay for me.
Mikayla: FWIW I ran stress on the kv-cache branch that landed in this PR and didn't see the regressions we saw last week. Not a blocker but adding context.
deploy-bot: CI status for PR #8123 — unit-tests ✅, integration-tests ✅, e2e — running :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
Alex K: LGTM pending final CI. Left a reply on the timeout comment — suggest `250ms -> 300ms` to be conservative.
Ryan M: Cool. If Alex signs, @Sara P can do the second signoff and execute the merge. Cutoff is 23:59 PT — aim to merge with at least 30m to monitor.
Sara P: Confirmed. I'll do merge + cutover as long as e2e is green. Re-running smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh --pr 8123` — will report back in ~3m.
deploy-bot: CI update: e2e ✅ — all checks passed.
Alex K: Formal signoff: LGTM :white_check_mark: (re-checked the timeout change and unit diffs)
Sara P: Second signoff from me. Merging now, will watch rollout for 30 minutes and rollback if any error rate spike. :rocket: 
Julian T: I'll shadow logs and be on pager for the window. Ping me if latency > baseline or error-rate > 0.5%.
Ryan M: Thanks everyone. Cutover ETA ~7m. Follow-up item: open a small ticket to revisit timeout heuristics next sprint so we don't have last-minute tuning.
